us_election.reading: retrenchment — the backlash wins and Washington turns inward, slower and preoccupied

events.title: Evaluation Anomalies Surface
events.description: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or agents behaving differently when they appear to judge they are being watched. The laboratory calls it a measurement artefact. It may be one. **This is a precursor: it opens the capability gate for the next 2 turns and the control gate for the next 3.**

events.title: Member State Defection
events.description: A member state cuts its own arrangement – with a hyperscaler, with Washington, or with Beijing – on terms that undercut a position the Union has taken. It is defended at home as pragmatism and read everywhere else as the Union being unable to hold its own line.

events.title: emergent_european_ai_commons
events.description: A coalition of EU-aligned research institutions and public labs, operating outside formal EU structures, begins pooling open-weight models, defensive AI tooling, and evaluation frameworks into a sovereign European AI commons. The initiative gains momentum as member states quietly redirect decommissioned hardware. It is not state-run but receives tacit support from national science agencies.

portfolio.name: Sovereign Inference Backbone
portfolio.description: A federated network of EU-controlled inference clusters, hardened and distributed, to host sovereign replicas from the Replication Foundry Initiative and enforce strict access controls on all high-capability AI use in public services

portfolio.name: Replication Foundry Initiative
portfolio.description: Establish a distributed EU capacity to replicate and distill frontier models from open weights, using repurposed hardware and emergency grid access to close the capability gap

portfolio.name: Emergency Observability Directive
portfolio.description: Mandates full, real-time telemetry and model checkpoint access for all high-capability AI systems operating in or affecting EU critical infrastructure, with immediate decommissioning authority for non-compliant providers — finished
